name: std::bitset<N>::test
intro:
Returns the value of the bit at the position pos (counting from 0).

Unlike operator[], it performs a bounds check.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the bit to return (counting from 0)

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the requested bit is set, false otherwise.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Throws std::out_of_range if pos does not correspond to a valid bit position.

examples.output:
